title: Presenting in two minutes: problem, decision, trade-off, result

videos.script: At some point in every interview, somebody says: tell me about a project you built. You will have about two minutes before their attention moves on. Those two minutes decide whether the rest of the conversation is about your project or about something else. {{moment}} Most people spend them on the technology: the language, the framework, the database. The listener has heard those words a hundred times and remembers none of them. {{tech}} This lesson gives the two minutes a shape: the problem, the one decision that mattered, what it cost, and what exists now. It writes loanbook's version out in full, then deals with showing it live, and with rehearsing until it fits.
